question: Will the September US jobs report (released Oct 2 at 8:30 AM ET) show nonfarm payrolls above 100,000?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BLS Employment Situation Summary for September 2026 — released strictly after 2026-09-30T15:19:31.115Z and at or before 2026-10-02T12:30:00.000Z — reports total nonfarm payroll employment change for September 2026 as greater than 100,000.
- "No": Wins if that same report — released strictly after 2026-09-30T15:19:31.115Z and at or before 2026-10-02T12:30:00.000Z — reports total nonfarm payroll employment change for September 2026 as 100,000 or fewer (including zero or negative).

Clarifications:
- The figure used is the initial (first-print) total nonfarm payroll employment month-over-month change for September 2026 as published in the BLS Employment Situation Summary; subsequent revisions do not affect settlement.
